summary: Frontend-only verification of the signup redesign: 4 dedicated URLs (/signup-salon-india, /signup-salon-us, /signup-restaurant-india, /signup-restaurant-us), legacy /signup-salon & /signup-restaurant toggles, new cream header with gold MS logo, region-aware placeholders, review-step pricing, live preview, and mobile viewport. All feature points pass.

issues: 'MIRACURL SUITE' logo text visibly truncated behind the 'Sign in →' button because both the SuiteLogo and the sign-in CTA use shrink-0; no document horizontal overflow but logo wordmark is clipped under the button. Consider shrinking logo text / hiding wordmark on sm:hidden or using min-w-0 + truncate on the logo text wrapper.

verified_feature_points.legacy_signup_salon: data-locked='0', business-type cards present, region toggle present, no signup-switch-links; clicking restaurant card → URL becomes /signup-restaurant, salon card → /signup-salon ✓
verified_feature_points.legacy_signup_restaurant: data-locked='0', cards + toggle present, no switch links ✓
verified_feature_points.layout: No signup-left-brand-panel on any page. signup-header present. suite-logo img src=/assets/ms-logo-gold.png, naturalWidth=495 (loads). Logo contains 'MIRACURL SUITE' + 'AI-POWERED BUSINESS MANAGEMENT PLATFORM' (text-transform:uppercase; subtitle present). signup-have-account href='/login'. No signup-trust-strip. Form card max-w-2xl centered ✓
verified_feature_points.live_preview_step1: signup-live-preview present on all 4 dedicated pages ✓ (logo upload button visible in screenshot)

trial_badges.salon pages: '30-DAY FREE TRIAL · NO CREDIT CARD · CANCEL ANYTIME' (from /api/public/plans trial_days=30) ✓
trial_badges.restaurant pages: 'FIRST MONTH FREE · NO CREDIT CARD · CANCEL ANYTIME' ✓

verified_feature_points.mobile_390x844_salon_india: No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390). Header, label chip, form card all visible ✓

action_items: (Optional / minor) Make signup header responsive on <420px so 'MIRACURL SUITE' wordmark isn't visually clipped behind the Sign in button — e.g. hide wordmark on sm:hidden, truncate, or let the logo wrapper shrink (remove shrink-0 on SuiteLogo and add min-w-0 + truncate on the text block).
critical_code_review_comments: SignupSalon.jsx is 604 lines — consider splitting SalonStep / OwnerStep / LocationStep / ReviewStep and the Stepper into separate files for maintainability (>700 line threshold is close).
parseSignupPath + signupPath are clean; locked state derived from pathRegion works correctly. Minor: pathType is destructured but never used after init since form.business_type carries it — fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 feature points pass; 1 cosmetic mobile observation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Signup redesign fully verified. Logo subtitle rendered uppercase via CSS — if asserting via inner_text, compare case-insensitively. Signup POST is rate-limited; stop at Review step. Legacy /signup-salon and /signup-restaurant still toggle via business-type cards; dedicated URLs enforce locked region (data-locked='1') and hide region toggle + business-type cards and show 3-item signup-switch-links at the bottom.
